about: Prompts of the illustrated lesson library: two original characters (Lan and Minh) in five places, 8 shots per place, generated once on a local GPU (motion-studio images-library) and reused by every lesson. No studio, film, channel or real person is named; both characters are adults in ordinary clothes.

base.license: CreativeML Open RAIL++-M (commercial use allowed, with the use restrictions of the licence)

image_encoder.license: Apache-2.0 (repo); the ViT-H/14 weights are MIT (LAION)

style: 3d animated movie still, cartoon style, warm cinematic light
negative: photo, photorealistic, 2d, flat illustration, anime, sketch, text, letters, watermark, logo, blurry, lowres, deformed, bad hands, extra fingers, cross-eyed, duplicate person, crowd, third person, child, teenager

her.name: Lan
her.look: a Vietnamese woman in her late 20s, shoulder-length black hair, mustard cardigan, white blouse
her.short: a young woman in a yellow cardigan

him.name: Minh
him.look: a Vietnamese man in his late 20s, short black hair, black glasses, navy sweater, blue shirt
him.short: a young man with glasses in a dark blue sweater

portrait: close-up portrait of {look}, stylized 3d cartoon character, big expressive eyes, friendly smile, facing the camera, plain warm grey background

classroom.setting: a bright classroom with a clean whiteboard, wooden desks and big windows
classroom.him: sitting at a desk with a notebook

interview.setting: a modern office meeting room with a glass wall and a plant
interview.her: sitting at the table with a folder

exam.setting: a quiet test room with a small table, two chairs and a wall clock
exam.her: sitting at the table holding papers

desk.setting: a cozy study corner with a desk, a laptop and a cork board
desk.him: at the desk with a laptop

cafe.setting: a warm cafe with wooden tables and plants
cafe.her: at a cafe table with a coffee
cafe.him: at a cafe table with a tea

both-her.prompt: two people talking, {her_short} on the left {her_pose}, speaking, {him_short} on the right {him_pose}, listening, medium wide shot, {setting}

both-him.prompt: two people talking, {her_short} on the left {her_pose}, listening, {him_short} on the right {him_pose}, speaking, medium wide shot, {setting}

her-1.prompt: medium close-up of {her_look}, {her_pose}, talking, warm smile, on the left of the frame, {setting}

her-2.prompt: medium shot of {her_look}, {her_pose}, explaining with an open hand, three-quarter view, {setting}

her-listen.prompt: close-up of {her_look}, {her_pose}, listening, gentle smile, on the left of the frame, {setting}

him-1.prompt: medium close-up of {him_look}, {him_pose}, talking, friendly smile, on the right of the frame, {setting}

him-2.prompt: medium shot of {him_look}, {him_pose}, explaining with one hand raised, three-quarter view, {setting}

him-listen.prompt: close-up of {him_look}, {him_pose}, listening, nodding, on the right of the frame, {setting}

review: Two-shots were drawn with --candidates 3 and checked by eye (2026-11-26): seeds lists the ones chosen; skip lists two-shots with no clean seed (clothes swapped or a third person), whose place uses its other two-shot for both speakers.
